MANDATORY_UNBOUNDED_PRODUCERS: Independent manager/kernel raw metadata and framing
PARTIAL_WRITE_ACCOUNTING: Encoded/successfully transferred record bytes are not cumulative bytes submitted to os.write. The sealed emit loop resubmits remaining suffixes on partial writes; that accounting must be independently bounded if included in future publication semantics.
PAYLOAD_EMIT_DERIVATION: At most START, BEFORE_EXIT and one except-block error emit. This excludes interpreter startup/stderr and independent capture/control records; source never executed.
SERVICE_CAPTURE_PLUS_OTHER_REQUIRED_RECO: 65536 + positive envelope/authority/claim/failure bytes exceeds65536 if worst capture retained in same publication budget. Not a complete exact deficit because other record schemas remain unbounded.
SMALLEST_REPAIR_REQUIREMENT: Exact closed publication schemas and raw-capture allocation plus protected critical reserve under65536; missing causal evidence must yield INCOMPLETE rather than unverified hash reference or silent truncation. No ceiling increase or full campaign budget import.
